intent_record.intent_summary: Refactor the active class check in ets_qdisc_change to use the cl_is_active helper function.
intent_record.what: Replaced the inline condition `i >= q->nstrict && q->classes[i].qdisc->q.qlen` with a call to the helper function `cl_is_active(&q->classes[i])`.
intent_record.how: Simplifies the check for whether a class is active by delegating the logic to an existing helper function.
